blocks.text: Killarney Secondary (6454 Killarney St) is a secondary school in Killarney. This is not a complete list of the schools nearby.

Living near a school does not mean a place at it. Your child's school comes from the district's catchment boundaries, and those change, so confirm the address with the district before you write an offer.
Source: BC Ministry of Education and Child Care school list (2025/26, updated July 2026) and the Province's post-secondary locations list. Neighbourhood placement is from our own area research.

faq.q: Is Killarney an official City of Vancouver area?
faq.a: Yes — Killarney is one of the City's 22 distinct local areas, in the southeastern corner of the city bordering Burnaby and the Fraser River; "Killarney VE" is the site slug for the same area in Vancouver East.

faq.q: Which schools are located in Killarney?
faq.a: Four VSB elementaries — Champlain Heights (6955 Frontenac Street), Cook (3340 East 54th Avenue), MacCorkindale (6100 Battison Street) and Weir (2900 East 44th Avenue) — and Killarney Secondary, 6454 Killarney Street; catchments are address-based, so check the exact address in the VSB locator.

faq.q: Is there a SkyTrain station in Killarney?
faq.a: No station sits inside the area in the sources read — Killarney is bus-served, with route 49 on 49th Avenue to Metrotown Station and UBC, route 26 to Joyce Station, and route 100 on Marine Drive to 22nd Street Station.

faq.q: What is the Fraserlands / River District?
faq.a: The recently developed waterfront at Killarney's south edge, built under the East Fraser Lands Official Development Plan — a mainly residential community with a variety of housing types and a commercial centre on the former Canadian White Pine Sawmill site.

faq.q: Is the Fraser River floodplain a factor in Killarney?
faq.a: Yes at the river edge — the City's designated floodplain includes the Fraser River coastal floodplain, with by-law setback and flood construction level requirements for parcels in it; a specific parcel's status must be checked in the City dataset.
